slides.title: How do you show up when nobody here knows you yet?

body.text: This is fighting to get both arms under a standing player's arms.

items: Whoever connects first wins by locking his hands around his partner's body, armpits to ankles.

body.text: This is getting close to a partner holding one of your legs.

items: The top player wins by getting under the bottom player's elbow and locking his own hands around him.
The bottom player wins by closing his legs around the top player's waist.

body.text: This is staying on top while sitting on his belly.

items: The top player holds as long as he keeps one of the bottom player's elbows covered.
The bottom player wins by touching both elbows to his body, or making the top player fall.

options.text: The top player holds as long as he keeps one of the bottom player's elbows covered.

slides.question: You and your partner are locked in an over-under tie, one arm over, one arm under, on both sides. What's the smart next move?

options.text: Fight to close your hands under his elbows.
options.feedback: Closing your hands under his elbows is how you arrive for real, not just show up.

options.text: Let go and grab a fresh new hold.
options.feedback: Keep fighting from where you already are.

options.text: Hold still and wait for him to move.
options.feedback: Keep working to close your hands.
